title: claude-broker base deferred backlog entry
description: A parked task on <ns>-backlog (prune-exempt). Also covers deferred-resolved; retrospectives are namespace-local free-form and are not a base type.

task_id.description: Unique task key. Namespaces constrain the format via a manifest extension (e.g. cb-YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>).

subject.description: Headline, readable in the summary projection.

deferred_reason.description: Why the task was parked; cb requires it on type:deferred via extension.
